data.title: Tag. Fitness
data.headline: Launching a Niche Performance Brand from a Standstill to a Community for Tag.
data.content:
1. About the project

Tag, a high-performance running apparel brand, had a premium product line but no direct-to-consumer (D2C) channel. Their entire business was reliant on inefficient, unscalable sales through third-party retailers and social media DMs, which offered zero brand control or access to vital customer data. They needed to launch their first-ever flagship e-commerce platform to build a real brand, own their customer relationships, and create a scalable revenue stream.

2. Our Solutions

Our solution was to architect and deploy their entire D2C ecosystem from the ground up, centered on our two core services: Website Design and Landing Pages.

Phase 1: High-Performance Website Design (The Foundation)

We built their complete e-commerce foundation on the Shopify 2.0 platform. This was broken into three key streams:

  • Technical SEO & Performance: To ensure the new site was visible from day one, we implemented a complete technical SEO strategy. This included configuring the HTTPS & SSL certificate, optimizing all meta titles and descriptions, and enforcing a clean H1-H2 header structure. We ensured all URLs were search-friendly before submitting the final sitemap to Google Search Console. Critically, we engineered advanced page speed optimization, implementing image compression and lazy loading to achieve sub-second load times.
  • Frictionless UX Design:We conducted a full UX/UI Design process, building all key site pages from scratch: the homepage, product listing pages (with filters), product detail pages, and a streamlined shopping cart and checkout. We applied Tag's brand identity, color palette, and typography consistently across all templates and implemented subtle animations and hover states to enhance user engagement. This was all validated through rigorous Responsive Design & Testing, including specific Touch-Friendly Optimization for all buttons and navigation.
  • Full E-commerce Website Setup: To bring the design to life, we handled the complete site setup. This involved inputting all website copy and media, uploading the full product catalog with all variants and descriptions, and integrating their chosen payment gateways. We configured the Shopify CMS admin panel for easy product and order management and integrated their entire lead capture and tracking stack, including Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, and TikTok Pixel.

Phase 2: Targeted Landing Pages

To maximize their ad spend right at launch, we designed a suite of high-impact Landing Pages. Each page featured a custom layout, custom UI elements, and micro-interactions to guide the user flow. We integrated crucial functionality & tracking for each campaign, including chat plugins and lead capture forms, ensuring every new visitor was tracked and converted efficiently.

data.title: Steel Works Seattle
data.headline: Forging a Digital Identity for Steel Works Seattle
data.content:
1. About the project

OneLink Marketing partnered with Steel Works Seattle, a leading steel fabrication company with 30 years of experience, to completely transform their digital presence. They were masters of their craft, but their online brand was confusing and failed to communicate their true capabilities.

2. Services Used

To solve their core identity problem and build a platform for growth, we provided our two key services:

  • Brand Identity: We conducted a deep analysis of their market position and two distinct customer profiles (B2C and B2B). This informed a new, cohesive brand strategy, messaging, and visual direction.
  • Custom Web Design & Development: We designed and built a new, high-performance website from the ground up, translating the new brand identity into a powerful, intuitive user experience.

3. The Problem

Steel Works Seattle faced a major identity crisis. They had two completely different customer profiles:

  1. Homeowners & Architects: Seeking artisanal, aesthetic products like custom gates, railings, and stairs.

  2. General Contractors & Developers: Needing a reliable, large-scale structural steel fabrication partner for commercial and industrial projects.

Their old website failed to speak to either group. It mixed messages, making large contractors feel SWS was too small ("they just make gates"), while homeowners found SWS too "industrial" and intimidating. Their brand felt fractured, and their website was failing as a business tool.

4. Our Solution

OneLink Marketing focuses on creating a single, powerful brand identity delivered through a strategic, custom-designed website.

Step 1: Unifying the Brand Identity

First, we solved their messaging problem. We developed a core brand strategy around the concept of "Masterful Steel at Every Scale." This new identity celebrated their dual expertise, positioning them as a single, sophisticated firm that could handle both intricate custom work and large-scale commercial structures with equal precision.

Step 2: Designing a Purpose-Driven Website

We translated this new brand identity into a custom website. The core of our web design was creating two distinct user journeys:

  • From the homepage, users are immediately guided to two clear paths: "Custom Metalwork" (for B2C) or "Commercial Services" (for B2B).

Step 3: Engineering a Segment-Specific User Experience (UX)

Our web development and UX design focused on building out these two paths to serve their specific audiences:

  • The Commercialsection was designed to build trust with B2B clients. It features technical language, highlights their advanced technology (CNC, automated beam lines), and showcases large-scale case studies. The primary call-to-action is "Get a Bid."
  • The Retailsection was designed to inspire. It functions as a beautiful, visual portfolio, emphasizing craftsmanship, aesthetics, and the collaborative design process. The primary call-to-action is "Schedule a Consultation."

data.title: China Sourcing Co
data.headline: Building a Conversion-Focused Digital Presence for China Sourcing Co
data.content:
1. About the project

China Sourcing Cois a sourcing service company that connects global businesses with reliable manufacturers across China. Despite having an extensive supplier network and a strong operational foundation, the company's online presence did not fully reflect its expertise and credibility.

The old website was outdated, hard to navigate, and lacked a clear brand narrative. Marketing activities were fragmented across channels, with no unified tracking or data integration.

That's when China Sourcing Co partnered with OneLink Marketing with three main goals:

  • Redesign the website with a modern, conversion-optimized layout.
  • Build a unified multi-channel marketing strategy to strengthen brand positioning.
  • Increase qualified leads while improving cost efficiency and user experience.

2. The Challenges

When we started, we identified three major bottlenecks:

1. Website not optimized for conversion: The old site had a cluttered layout and lacked clear CTAs, leading to a high bounce rate and low quote submissions.

2. Inconsistent brand presence:Messaging, visuals, and tone across social platforms didn't align with the company's professional positioning.

3. Lack of tracking and data insights: There was no proper lead-tracking or analytics system, making it difficult to measure performance or optimize ad spend.

3. Our Solutions

After a full audit of China Sourcing Co's digital ecosystem, we built a five-phase roadmap to reconstruct their online presence and marketing foundation.

1. Website Redesign & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

The core of the project was a complete website redesign — transforming it from a static company page into a conversion-driven digital engine.

Our approach included:

  • A modern, minimalist interface emphasizing professionalism and sourcing expertise.
  • Restructured content flow following a clear conversion funnel (Awareness → Consideration → Action).
  • Strategic call-to-action placements such as "Get a Quote" and "Talk to a Sourcing Expert".
  • Mobile-first, high-speed UX design optimized for B2B engagement.
  • A/B testing on landing pages to find the best-performing layouts.
  • Integrated analytics stack (GA4, Tag Manager) for real-time tracking.

Result:

  • The redesigned site increased user engagement and improved navigation clarity.
  • "Get a Quote" submissions rose by 192% within the first 90 days.

2. SEO & Content Strategy

To build sustainable organic growth, we implemented a 6-month SEO roadmap covering:

  • In-depth keyword research targeting sourcing, manufacturing, and logistics.
  • Full on-page optimization (meta, internal linking, schema markup).
  • Creation of content pillars like: "Vietnam vs China Sourcing," "How to Find Reliable Suppliers."
  • Off-page link building through digital PR and guest posts.

Result:

  • Organic traffic increased 2.4x.
  • Top 10 keyword rankings rose by 110% within 3 months.

3. Social Media Marketing

We redefined brand voice and visual identity for LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (Twitter).

Execution:

  • Built a 3-month content calendar focused on Factory Insights, Client Stories, and Industry Trends.
  • Designed cohesive post templates and storytelling visuals.

Result:

  • Engagement rate improved by 145%.
  • Significant rise in inbound inquiries from US, Australia, and Europe.

Before

After

4. Email Marketing & Lead Nurturing

To maximize conversion potential, we developed a targeted email nurture flow that guided leads through every stage of decision-making.

Actions taken:

  • Automated welcome + sourcing guide + case study email flow.
  • Segmented leads into hot, warm, and cold tiers for personalization.
  • Redesigned email templates consistent with the new website design.

5. Reporting & Performance Insights

Transparency and agility were key to this partnership. We created a live dashboard consolidating data from all channels to monitor daily performance.

What we delivered:

  • Real-time tracking of traffic, leads, and conversion costs.
  • Weekly performance reviews and creative adjustments.
  • Quarterly executive reports to measure ROI.

4. Key Results

Within just 90 days, China Sourcing Co saw measurable growth across every key performance metric.

The new website redesign alone drove a 192% increase in conversion rate, rising from 1.2% to 3.5%. Organic traffic also surged by 240% thanks to a well-structured SEO strategy.

On social media, engagement on LinkedIn grew by 145%. User behavior metrics improved with average session duration increasing from 38s to 1m 4s.

Meanwhile, the new email marketing flow helped re-engage cold leads, achieving a 30% reactivation rate.

5. Conclusion

China Sourcing Co's project demonstrates how a data-driven redesign combined with a multi-channel strategy can accelerate real business growth.

Through OneLink Marketing's blend of creative direction, performance tracking, and ongoing optimization, China Sourcing Co transformed its digital presence into a trusted sourcing platform with measurable ROI.

data.title: Vietnam Sourcing Co
data.headline: Boosting Vietnam Sourcing Co’s Digital Presence and Lead Generation
data.content:
1. About the project

Vietnam Sourcing Co is a sourcing and manufacturing service provider based in Vietnam, helping international buyers find reliable factories and manage production efficiently.

Although the company had strong expertise and a wide factory network, its digital presence didn't reflect its true capabilities.The old website was not SEO-optimized, the brand story lacked clarity, and content failed to communicate Vietnam's growing manufacturing strength to international clients.

That's when Vietnam Sourcing Co partnered with OneLink Marketing to translate their operational excellence into a strong digital identity that drives visibility, credibility, and qualified leads from around the world.

2. The Challenges

Before the partnership, Vietnam Sourcing Co faced three major challenges:

1. Limited global brand awareness: Despite their strong service quality, they lacked recognition among international buyers.

2. Underperforming website & low organic visibility: Their pages were not targeting high-intent keywords like “Vietnam sourcing company” or “manufacturing partner in Vietnam”, resulting in minimal search traffic.

3. Low conversion rate: Website visitors were not converting into leads due to weak UX, unclear CTAs, and lack of nurturing.

3. Our Solutions

1. Brand Positioning & Messaging Framework

We started by redefining Vietnam Sourcing Co's brand narrative—from a simple sourcing agency to “a strategic partner helping global businesses manufacture smarter in Vietnam.”

This new positioning became the foundation of all marketing communication. It emphasized human connection, transparency, and local expertise, the key values international clients look for when choosing a sourcing partner.

2. SEO & Website Overhaul

  • Conducted in-depth keyword research to identify high-value commercial keywords like Vietnam sourcing, product sourcing Vietnam, and manufacturing in Vietnam.
  • Rewrote website content to be clear, search-intent aligned, and professional in tone for global B2B readers.
  • Improved technical SEO, website speed, and internal linking structure.
  • Implemented a strong off-page SEO strategy with authoritative backlinks from global trade and industry sites.

Within just 4 months, the website started ranking in Google's Top 3 (with those important keywords) for highly competitive sourcing-related terms.

3. Social Media Marketing: Human-Centered Storytelling

Our team developed a human-centered content strategy, highlighting authentic factory stories, manufacturing insights, and local perspectives from Vietnam.

Each post was crafted to emotionally resonate with business audiences, showing transparency, real people, and real expertise while reinforcing brand trust.

We also established a cohesive visual identity systemto ensure every post reflected Vietnam Sourcing Co's brand values of reliability and precision.

4. Conversion Optimization & Email Automation

We then focused on turning traffic into leads:

  • Redesigned CTAs and optimized inquiry forms
  • Created an automated 7-day nurturing funnel for new leads
  • Segmented audiences based on behavior (catalog downloads, inquiry form submissions, link clicks)
  • Personalized follow-up emails to drive engagement

This approach steadily increased inbound leads from the U.S., Australia, and the EU, establishing a sustainable pipeline of qualified prospects.

4. Key Results

After 4 months of implementation, Vietnam Sourcing Co achieved measurable growth:

  • +187% organic traffic growth
  • Top 1 Google rankings for “Vietnam sourcing company” and “product sourcing in Vietnam”
  • Steady inbound leads from verified international buyers (U.S., Australia, EU)
  • +45% session duration and -30% bounce rate, showing stronger engagement

Boosted brand authority, positioning Vietnam Sourcing Co as a credible global sourcing partner

Bheki,

General Manager

“Before working with the agency, we were doing great work but nobody knew about it online. Now, our content and SEO strategy consistently bring in the right leads and help us tell the Vietnam sourcing story the way it deserves to be told.”

5. Key Takeaway

  • The partnership between OneLink Marketing and Vietnam Sourcing Co demonstrates how a strategic, full-funnel marketing approach can turn operational expertise into brand power.
  • By combining SEO, content, social media, and conversion optimization, we helped Vietnam Sourcing Co not only attract visibility but convert it into business growth.
  • Today, the company stands as one of Vietnam's most trusted sourcing partners for global buyers, with a digital presence that truly reflects its value.
